propositions: Findings longer than 240 characters are clipped mid-sentence with no ellipsis or marker, so the author cannot tell text was removed.
When more than 10 blocking findings exist, the extras are dropped with no 'N more' note, understating the work required.
The header claims the full count (e.g. 11) while only 10 bullets are shown, making the truncated comment read as complete.
The truncation is inconsistent with the module's own convention of emitting an explicit truncation marker in voter.py.
A clipped finding must end with an explicit marker and over-cap findings must disclose the omitted count while keeping the cap.
Full finding detail must remain discoverable in the machine-readable adapter result even though the posted comment is bounded.
